name: Bag Check
summary: A file scan tracker built as an airport x-ray: your file rides the belt and gets a real check
about: A scan progress tracker where any file you choose, drop or paste becomes a suitcase on a conveyor belt. Inside the x-ray tunnel the monitor paints the file's real bytes in airport colours while five checks tick through: reading every byte, the real type from its signature against its name, hidden code such as scripts or macros, randomness in bits per byte, and the size to send. The bag rolls out and gets stamped Cleared, Check or Stop with the reasons.
how: Press Choose a file, drop a file on the card or paste one; nothing is uploaded
Watch the bag roll into the tunnel while the x-ray picture and the five checks fill in
A file whose name hides its type, or that carries scripts or macros, is stamped Check or Stop with the reasons
Press Try a sample to run the three built-in files: a menu PDF, a fake PNG and a ZIP
